sections.changelog:
Added

  • Smart contact input: branch and button contacts now accept a bare phone number or username and auto-expand to the correct link by button type (phone → `tel:`, WhatsApp → `wa.me`, Viber → `viber://`, Telegram → `t.me`, email → `mailto:`, social networks → their canonical profile URL). Full links and existing values are kept untouched.

Changed

  • Submit areas use the UI Kit `.mvweb-submit` component (with a `.mvweb-submit--cb` modifier for the reset button and inline spinner) instead of the custom `.mvweb-cb-save-area`
  • Empty states (Buttons, Branches tabs) use semantic `

    ` / `

    ` and inline SVG icons instead of `

    ` and Dashicons

  • Save spinner visibility is controlled via `.mvweb-cb-spinner--active` (visibility) instead of the legacy `.is-active` display toggle
  • Moved inline `max-width` styles on z-index and Yandex.Metrika counter inputs into dedicated CSS classes
  • Contact input placeholders updated to reflect the new number/username-friendly format

Fixed

  • Custom buttons without an uploaded image no longer show a broken-image icon — a neutral link icon is used as the default
  • Completed Russian translation: 20 previously untranslated admin strings (labels, placeholders, JS notices) are now localized
  • Per-button contact URL/text now always takes priority over the branch default when filled in manually; an empty field cleanly falls back to the branch default (shown as a placeholder hint)
